purpose: Teach: 経ち/冷房/断然/少量/丸く/傾い/羽目/延ばし

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 夏が経ち、もう秋の気配ね。
lines.en: Summer's already slipping away… autumn's right at our doorstep.
lines.style: Soft, observant opening. Warm nostalgia—not quite melancholy. Gentle trailing-off on the ellipsis, like noticing something that's been happening without you realizing it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。冷房、控えめにしてる。
lines.en: Yeah. I've been keeping the AC dialed back.
lines.style: Quiet agreement. Understated smile in the voice. Acknowledging without fanfare. Light, natural pacing—she's already thinking the same thing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: カフェのケーキ、断然、こちらの店が美味しい。
lines.en: Though honestly, the cakes here are so much better than anywhere else.
lines.style: Lighter lift in tone—genuine enthusiasm breaking through. Relaxed, direct conviction. No performance, just saying something she's noticed and wants to share.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 砂糖、少量で、健康にいい。
lines.en: We use less sugar. It's the better choice, really.
lines.style: Humble, matter-of-fact. No pride in it—just stating something true. Quiet steadiness. The kind of thing said while moving cups or adjusting something small.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 丸く焼き上がったクッキー、可愛い。
lines.en: And these round cookies—they're just so charming.
lines.style: Brightness and softness together. Genuine delight in noticing something small and good. Slight lift on 'charming'—she's inviting agreement but not demanding it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 店の看板、台風で傾いた。
lines.en: Our shop sign got knocked sideways in that typhoon, actually.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly wry undercurrent. Observing the small damage with quiet acceptance. Not complaining—just noticing how things shift.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 長居しすぎて、夕飯遅くなる羽目に。
lines.en: I stayed so long I've completely thrown my dinner off schedule.
lines.style: Self-aware humor. Light rufulness—poking fun at herself. Conversational, natural pace. A small laugh underneath, like she knows exactly how this keeps happening.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 今夜の予定、また延ばしになりそう。
lines.en: Looks like my evening plans are getting pushed back again.
lines.style: Wry, knowing tone. Shared resignation between friends. Slow, comfortable acceptance. The smile of someone who's learned this is just how it goes.
